Noah: Heads-up 8am UTC9 Novu Labs hit a sudden embedding spend spike during onboarding. Can someone triage for QBR notes? :warning:
Priya: I see it. Dashboard link: https://console.redwood/clients/novu-labs/spend daily tokens ~1.9M projected monthly ~57M if unchanged.
Carlos: quick triage: probable full-history import without chunking. Immediate steps: enable batching (batch_size=128), run lightweight dedupe, offer temp throttle.
Noah: OpsBot posted raw alert: OpsBot: [budget-sentinel] NOVU-88 exceeded threshold: today_tokens=1,905,412 trigger=embed-ingest. Suggested action: temp-throttle, notify FinOps.
Priya: Can FinOps convert tokens->USD for 3 scenarios by EOD tomorrow: (1) throttle+dedupe+batching (2) batching+quant (3) baseline. We need slide-ready numbers and a one-line takeaway.
FinOpsBot: Ack. Will post three scenario rows and a sensitivity table (25/50/100% adoption) by EOD tomorrow.
Carlos: SQL I use to break down routes for the deck:
```
SELECT route, sum(tokens) as tokens, sum(cost_usd) as cost
FROM token_events
WHERE account_id='NOVU-88' AND ts >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY tokens DESC;
```
Noah: I'll schedule a 25m enablement with their eng lead tomorrow to demo Optimize presets and collect any doc feedback for the QBR renewal slide. If they accept a throttle, mark renewal risk amber; if they adopt presets within 7 days mark green.
Priya: I'll draft the customer note and include a checkbox for "ENABLE TEMP THROTTLE". Paste customer quotes here after the call and I'll stitch into the QBR.
